just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gs4 and dwells most on F# in Delkash. Forud (2:27.6) introduces C#, centred on F#. The line peaks at C#5 (561.8 Hz) at 2:28.3. It closes on C#4, not the tonic (D#4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → F#4 → C#4).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.
